types.name: create
types.description:
This method creates an RBAC policy. It sends a request to the Create RBAC Policy
API route.
types.example: sdk.admin.rbacPolicy.create({ key: "product.read", resource: "product", operation: "read" }) .then(({ policy }) => { console.log(policy) })
